description: This Java source file implements the WebUserServices interface, providing user details retrieval and default admin creation functionalities for the application security module. It interacts with user, group, permission, and merchant store services to load user details for authentication and to set up default admin users.

classes.name: UserServicesImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing user details retrieval for Spring Security and providing default admin creation functionality.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details and authorities for authentication based on username.

methods.name: createDefaultAdmin
methods.description: Creates a default administrator user with predefined roles and permissions, used for initial setup.
